then.text: The pool is still. A warm breeze, smelling of woodsmoke, drifts across the water. She is somewhere nearby, and content.

else.text: The pool ripples. A warm wind finds its way into the cave, though there is no wind.
All four Stones in your pocket hum together. The water begins to glow red.

then.text: Y Ddraig Goch has chosen to walk beside you. It is, you suspect, the best flag-related decision in the history of Wales.

else.text: The Dragon slips back under the water, snorting steam. The pool goes quiet. She will wait, if you want to try again.
A quiet pool in a cave under the mountain. The water is very still, and very old.
Somewhere below, something very large turns over in its sleep. A rumble, then silence.
Whatever lives here is not ready to meet you. Perhaps you have more Stones to find.
